details: Basically the Idea is for friends and loved ones alike be allowed to join someone of there choosing whenever. So take for example me and this other person both have this subscription and i add them to my list to allow them to join me whenever they want whether I'm on orange or not. Ofc you are allowed to turn this feature off for private reasons/ want to be left alone. but this will help combat relationship issues within the game allowing loved ones to join and leave as they please which gives security to those in a relationship. for example your partner is not responding to messages but they are online and you cant join them because they are sleeping or for whatever reason. this would reduce anxiety, trust issues, relationship trauma, etc. this also should be separate from VRC + ofc because of how valuable this feature is. This is a valid feature request and doable  and if i don't get a response I'm just going to assume you guys hate this community and this is an easy way to make some money and something i would 100% get for myself and partner. if you have any thoughts whoever is reading this let me know id be happy to answer any questions. this will probably be my only post on here so feel free to add my discord to talk further. nexi1234
title: New Feature RQ: Join Whenever Subscription
